verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਕੁ ਓੜਕੁ ਭਾਲਿ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: oRak oRak bhaal na oRak paiaa|

en.bdb: In order to know Him, people put in extreme efforts but could not know His extant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਕ ਭਾਲਣਿ ਗਏ ਸਿ ਫੇਰ ਨ ਆਇਆ॥
verses.translit_en: oRak bhaalan ge s fer na aaiaa||

en.bdb: Those who went out to know His bounds could never return.
To know Him, myriads of people have remained wandering in illusions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਨ ਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh vaddaa visamaadh na a(n)t sunaiaa|

en.bdb: That primeval Lord is the grand wonder whose mystery cannot be understood by mere listening.
His waves, shades etc are limitless.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau na alakh lakhaiaa|

en.bdb: The imperceptible Lord who has created all through His single vibration cannot be perceived.
I am sacrifice unto that creator, whose maya is this creation.
The Guru has made me understand that God alone knows about His own self (none else can know Him).
